name: KALARA DISTRO — Customer Service AI Chatbot (n8n Cloud)

parameters.content:
## PANDUAN SETUP CS AI KALARA DISTRO DI N8N CLOUD
1. Klik 2x node **Google Gemini Chat Model** → pilih/buat Credential API Key (atau ganti node model ke OpenAI / Groq / Anthropic).
2. *(Opsional)* Klik 2x **Webhook Customer Chat** → Authentication: **Header Auth** jika ingin menambah token keamanan.
3. Klik tombol **Save** lalu **AKTIFKAN toggle Inactive → Active / Publish** di pojok kanan atas sampai berwarna hijau.
4. Buka node **Webhook Customer Chat** → tab **Webhook URLs** → pilih **Production URL** (bukan Test URL) lalu salin URL `https://<workspace>.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/kalara-cs-chat`.
5. Tempel URL tersebut ke secret **N8N_WEBHOOK_URL** di Settings > Secrets (AI Studio) atau Environment Variables (Vercel).
